title: 绣像义妖传 · 卷1–3
titleEn: Illustrated Tale of the Righteous Demon · vols. 1–3
source: 清代弹词刻本 · 繡像義妖傳 卷1–3（白蛇故事系统）（全书 110 页 PDF）
sourceEn: Qing-era tanci print: Illustrated Yi Yao Zhuan, vols. 1–3 (White Snake cycle) — full 110-page PDF

reading.zh: 《义妖传》属白蛇故事弹词系统，写白娘子与许仙的姻缘、法海阻挠与西湖断桥等情节。
reading.zhHant: 《義妖傳》屬白蛇故事彈詞系統，寫白娘子與許仙的姻緣、法海阻撓與西湖斷橋等情節。
reading.en: Yi Yao Zhuan belongs to the White Snake tanci cycle: Bai Niangzi and Xu Xian, interrupted by Fahai, with the Broken Bridge among its famous scenes.
